subject: Re: Kickoff: ARDMs for budget-adaptive generation and compression
body:
Zofia,

Staffing: Efe 70% on modeling, Saoirse 50% on training infra, through the window.

The bigger item is data readiness. The compression benchmark is only meaningful if the training corpora are clean - duplicate examples inflate compression numbers and quietly leak into eval splits. To get there we're scoping and building a dataset de-duplication pipeline from scratch - MinHash/LSH near-dup detection over the text and audio corpora, with exact-dup hashing as a first stage. Halima leads it at 50% with Tereza at 40%; there's no existing internal pipeline that does this, so we're treating it as new shared infrastructure we'll own.

Compute: 64-128 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort for training; no Vulcan reservation needed at ARDM scale.

De-dup pipeline MVP by 3/27, which keeps the compression numbers on track for end of March... realistically first week of April.

Alina
